title: Beyond the Skew-Stickiness Ratio: Transport Geometry of Spot-Driven Variance Surface Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2608.12493v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We develop a geometric theory of arbitrage-free implied variance surface dynamics. Smile dynamics are formulated as transport flows on the admissible class of static-arbitrage-free surfaces: spot movements generate transport vector fields, and the transport velocity field v(k) unifies all classical stickiness regimes. The skew-stickiness ratio (SSR) is the zeroth-order transport coefficient; higher-order coefficients govern ATM skew, curvature, and higher smile derivatives. A local jet transport corollary extends the theory to arbitrary log-moneyness and identifies v(k) nonparametrically from market data. Under explicit regularity conditions, the flow preserves butterfly and calendar arbitrage-freeness locally. Sticky-strike, sticky-delta, SSR, local volatility, and rough volatility all arise as special cases within this framework.   Empirically, we apply a sequential forward-substitution estimator to five years of SPX implied-volatility

translated_title: 超越偏斜-粘性比率：现货驱动的方差曲面动态的传输几何
translated_abstract: 我们发展了一个无套利隐含方差曲面动态的几何理论。微笑动态被表述为静态无套利曲面可容许类别上的传输流：现货运动生成传输向量场，传输速度场v(k)统一了所有经典的粘性机制。偏斜-粘性比率（SSR）是零阶传输系数；高阶系数控制ATM偏斜、曲率及更高微笑导数。一个局部喷流传输推论将该理论扩展到任意对数货币性，并从市场数据中非参数地识别v(k)。在明确的正则性条件下，该流局部保持蝶式和日历无套利性。粘性执行价、粘性delta、SSR、局部波动率和粗糙波动率均作为该框架内的特例出现。实证上，我们将序贯前向替换估计器应用于五年的SPX隐含波动率数据。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于传输几何的统一理论，将多种波动率微笑动态机制（如粘性执行价、粘性delta、SSR等）纳入同一框架，并通过非参数方法从市场数据中识别传输速度场。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a unified geometric transport theory that encompasses various smile dynamics regimes (e.g., sticky-strike, sticky-delta, SSR) and identifies the transport velocity field nonparametrically from market data.
